name: Placentia Library Teen Volunteers and Teen Action Crew
what_you_do: Shelve books, clean materials or help at the makerspace and big events. You can join the Teen Action Crew to plan teen events, or write book reviews for hours.
who_can_apply: Teens 12 to 17. You need an active Placentia Library card and a personal email. School email will not work. The Teen Review Crew is for high school students only.
pay_detail: Volunteer. You earn community service hours.
duration: Three month commitment for assigned jobs. Shelving is 2 hours once a week.
deadline_text: The library says it is now accepting new volunteers. No deadline is posted. The Teen Action Crew meets the 1st and 3rd Thursday, 5:00 to 7:00 p.m.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form for ages 12 to 17 on the volunteer page. Then finish the online orientation within 7 days of getting the link. The Teen Action Crew needs no form, but you need the orientation to earn hours.
notes: A form does not promise you a spot. Shelving can have a waitlist. Book reviews earn 4 hours per book, up to 20 hours a calendar year. Hours are signed after you reach 10, and it takes 2 weeks. Email volunteers@placentialibrarydistrict.ca.gov or call (714) 528-1906.
